clips.title: The story
paras: The Ripped Missive is a blood-spattered letter recovered from Haalien that sheds light on a brutal cultist assault against a druid den in Shadowgale Forest. Its contents expose the callous motives behind the slaughter and hint at dangerous subversion originating from within Valanaar.

Tucked behind the bracer of Haalien, this torn and bloodstained document holds grim intelligence concerning the recent violence in Shadowgale Forest. Recovered after a fierce skirmish, the scrap of writing sheds light on the dark intentions of the cultists who fell upon the local druid den, offering vital clues for those seeking justice for the fallen.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.

clips.title: Completion
paras: They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?
They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.
Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
